text:
Maria Li: opened a draft PR for 0.10.0 changelog. focus: smart routing, canary rollouts, and Dedicated autoscale tweaks. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4102 :memo:

Samir Kapoor: nice. any known issues to call out? we should be transparent about the rollout quirks.

Maria Li: one: alias resolution during canary can occasionally route to the previous model version for 1-2s after a rollout commit. low frequency but could confuse pinned-version users. second: Dedicated autoscale rule change might briefly spike queued requests while pools resize.

Lena Park: for the alias issue, suggested user text: "Intermittent alias routing: during rapid canary rollouts, alias resolution may momentarily return prior model variant; if you require strict version pinning, specify the full model id (e.g., rwd-model-v2.1)."

Evan Wu: add a short SDK snippet for explicit version pinning. small python + go examples so customers can copy/paste.

Maria Li: adding both. please sanity-check: 
```py
# Python SDK: pin model id to avoid alias jitter
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'])
resp = client.generate(model='rwd-llama-7b-v2.1', input='Summarize...')
```

```go
// Go SDK: explicit model id
c := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("RW_KEY"))
resp, _ := c.Generate(context.Background(), redwood.GenerateParams{Model: "rwd-llama-7b-v2.1", Input: "Summarize..."})
```

Samir Kapoor: good. also add a short migration note: explain how to move from alias-based rollouts to pinned IDs and how to adopt canary weighting with fallback. one-sentence bullet on changelog, full guide in /guides/deployments/canary-rollouts.md.

Lena Park: I'll do the link fixes — ensure changelog entry points to the canary guide, the dedicated autoscaling docs, and the SDK examples page. Also sweep for old links to "rollout docs" that pointed to the internal prototype.

Maria Li: thanks. Docs Bot: please add QA checklist to the PR template: "verify alias resolution under 1000 qps for at least 2 consecutive commits" and "validate Dedicated autoscale behavior with synthetic burst test".

Docs Bot: Checklist added to PR #4102 as comment (requested by Maria Li).

Evan Wu: one more: wording for autoscale note: "Dedicated autoscale adjustments may briefly increase queueing during pool rebalancing. Mitigation: configure soft-burst with buffer capacity and enable graceful draining." short and actionable.

Samir Kapoor: approving wording. Lena, assign me if you want a second pass on links.

Lena Park: will do link sweep tomorrow and add the SDK snippets to /examples/sdk-snippets.md. tagging @Samir Kapoor for review.

Maria Li: thanks team — two approvals and we can merge once CI passes. tagging for visibility: @Samir Kapoor @Lena Park :rocket:
